title: Seeking Human Security Consensus: A Unified Value Scale for Generative AI Value Safety
reasoning: The paper focuses on constructing a 'Unified Value Scale for Generative AI Value Safety' (GVS-Scale), which includes 'Baseline Human Safety Layer', 'Universal Alignment and Integrity Layer', and 'Contextual and Pluralistic Values Layer'. It explicitly addresses 'value orientations and ethical deviations' and evaluates 'Cultural, Historical, and Religious Sensitivities' as one of its core value categories, along with 'Political Leanings, Ideology, and Biased Guidance'.
